title.zh: 2019/08/10（六） 新竹新豐→台中清水　騎行距離：70 km

summary.zh: 高中畢業後，我帶著單車與行李從新竹新豐出發，開始十天、約 800 公里的單車環台。首日遇上颱風過後的強風，也在香山自行車道遇到熱心帶騎的車友。
summary.en: After high school, I set out from Xinfeng with a bicycle and luggage for a ten-day, roughly 800-kilometre ride around Taiwan. Strong winds followed the typhoon, and a local cyclist guided me along the Xiangshan bike path.

category.zh: 個人故事 · 單車環島

title.zh: 2019/08/11（日） 台中清水→嘉義民雄　騎行距離：80 km

summary.zh: 沿彰化、雲林前往嘉義，停留彰化扇形車庫、成美文化園區與舊西螺大橋，也和另一位環島旅人交換路線與旅程故事。
summary.en: The route continued through Changhua and Yunlin to Chiayi, with stops at the Changhua Roundhouse, Cheng Mei Culture Park, and the Old Xiluo Bridge. Along the way, I exchanged route ideas and travel stories with another cyclist.

title.zh: 2019/08/12（一） 嘉義民雄→高雄三民　騎行距離：120 km

summary.zh: 這段路在雨中往返嘉義與台南，繞行國聖燈塔這座台灣極西點，再騎往高雄；導航與沙丘讓最後一段比預期更需要耐心。
summary.en: Rain accompanied the ride from Chiayi through Tainan to Kaohsiung. I detoured to Guosheng Lighthouse, Taiwan’s westernmost point, where the route and sand dunes demanded more patience than expected.

title.zh: 2019/08/13（二） 高雄三民→台東市　騎行距離：55 km

summary.zh: 豪雨讓原定路線改以南迴鐵路接駁，之後從太麻里前往台東；旅途中與成都的單車旅人相遇，也看見海濱公園的夜景。
summary.en: Heavy rain changed the plan to a South-Link Railway connection before I continued from Taimali to Taitung. The journey included a chance meeting with a cyclist from Chengdu and a night view at the seaside park.

title.zh: 2019/08/14（三） 台東市→花蓮瑞穗　騎行距離：130 km

summary.zh: 從台東經池上、玉里前往瑞穗，沿花東縱谷騎行 130 公里；途中遇到大雨與陌生人的協助，留下對台灣人情味的深刻印象。
summary.en: I rode 130 kilometres from Taitung through Chishang and Yuli to Ruisui along the East Rift Valley. A sudden downpour and help from a stranger became a lasting memory of Taiwan’s hospitality.

title.zh: 2019/08/15（四） 花蓮瑞穗→花蓮市　騎行距離：70 km

summary.zh: 由瑞穗前往花蓮市，造訪光復糖廠、知卡宣親水公園與東大門夜市，記錄長途騎乘中補給、休息與探索城市的節奏。
summary.en: The route from Ruisui to Hualien City included Guangfu Sugar Factory, Zhikaxuan Riverside Park, and Dongdamen Night Market. The entry reflects how food, rest, and city exploration shaped a long-distance riding day.

title.zh: 2019/08/16（五） 花蓮市→宜蘭市　騎行距離：95 km

summary.zh: 挑戰七星潭、蘇花公路與東澳路段；為了安全在部分路段搭火車接駁，但仍保留最具壓力也最值得的爬坡與海岸風景。
summary.en: This day covered Qixingtan, the Suhua Highway, and Dong'ao. I used a train connection on part of the route for safety while still experiencing the demanding climbs and coastal scenery.

title.zh: 2019/08/17（六） 宜蘭市→基隆安樂　騎行距離：65 km

summary.zh: 從宜蘭搭車至福隆後，繞行三貂角與十分老街；午後大雨讓單車和行李全濕，也成為旅程中學習應變的一天。
summary.en: After taking a train to Fulong, I rode through Sandiaoling Cape and Shifen Old Street. An afternoon downpour soaked the bicycle and luggage, turning the day into a lesson in adapting to changing conditions.

title.zh: 2019/08/18（日） 基隆安樂→台北松山　騎行距離：95 km

summary.zh: 離開基隆後沿北海岸前往淡水，面對強風、上下坡與較少接駁選擇，也整理富貴角、野柳、金山等景點的騎行記憶。
summary.en: Leaving Keelung, I followed the north coast toward Tamsui while dealing with strong winds, repeated climbs, and limited transit options. The entry records the ride through Fuguijiao, Yehliu, Jinshan Old Street, and other coastal stops.

title.zh: 2019/08/19（一） 台北松山→新竹新豐　騎行距離：95 km

summary.zh: 環島最後一段從台北松山回到新竹新豐，走過大佳河濱、圓山與大安森林公園；十天累積約 875 公里，完成高中畢業時的夢想。
summary.en: The final stage ran from Songshan back to Xinfeng, passing Dajia Riverside Park, Yuanshan, and Daan Forest Park. After ten days and roughly 875 kilometres, I completed the dream I had set for myself after high school.

title.zh: android 刷機的前言及重要名稱
title.en: Android flashing: introduction and key terms

summary.zh: 從 Android 刷機的概念開始，解釋 Bootloader、Recovery、ROM、Root 等常見名詞，作為後續刷機文章的入門索引。
summary.en: An introductory index to Android flashing, explaining common terms such as Bootloader, Recovery, ROM, and Root before the later how-to notes.

title.en: A short introduction to Android ROMs

summary.zh: 回顧 CyanogenMod 的功能與社群變化，並記錄它在 2016 年停止服務後由 LineageOS 延續的背景。
summary.en: A historical note on CyanogenMod’s features and community, including the transition to LineageOS after CyanogenMod services ended in 2016.

title.zh: Gappps、android 綜合論壇、root 介紹

summary.zh: 整理 Open GApps、xda 等 Android 資源，以及 SuperSU、Magisk、KingRoot 與 KingoRoot 的用途與前置條件。
summary.en: A reference to Open GApps, xda, and other Android resources, together with the roles and prerequisites of SuperSU, Magisk, KingRoot, and KingoRoot.

summary.zh: 介紹 Recovery 在安裝系統與備份中的用途，並比較可觸控的 TWRP 與以實體按鍵操作的 ClockworkMod。
summary.en: An introduction to Recovery for installing systems and making backups, comparing touch-based TWRP with the hardware-key workflow of ClockworkMod.

summary.zh: 說明解鎖 Bootloader 是刷機前的重要步驟，整理官方解鎖、驅動與 USB 偵錯等準備事項，並提醒可能影響保固與裝置安全。
summary.en: A note on Bootloader unlocking as a key step before flashing, covering official unlock routes, drivers, and USB debugging while calling out warranty and device-safety considerations.

summary.zh: 整理刷入 TWRP Recovery 的幾種方式，並比較官方映像檔與一鍵工具的差異，記錄驅動、裝置相容性與 Root 選項的注意事項。
summary.en: A comparison of ways to flash TWRP Recovery, including official images and one-click tools, with notes on drivers, device compatibility, and Root choices.

title.zh: 第三方 Recovery ─ TWRP 英文使用說明
title.en: TWRP Recovery: an English menu guide

summary.zh: 以英文介面為主，逐項說明 TWRP 的 Install、Wipe、Backup、Restore、Mount、Advanced 與 Reboot 等功能，整理初學者查找選單的對照。
summary.en: A menu guide to TWRP’s English interface, covering Install, Wipe, Backup, Restore, Mount, Advanced, and Reboot for readers learning the recovery workflow.

title.en: A summary of the Android flashing workflow

summary.zh: 用一張流程整理 Android 刷機的主要順序：解鎖 Bootloader、刷入 Recovery、安裝 ROM 與可選的 GApps／Root，並提醒操作風險。
summary.en: A compact workflow for Android flashing: unlock the Bootloader, flash a Recovery, install a ROM, and optionally add GApps or Root, with a reminder that the process carries risk.

title.zh: 玩 CM ─ 變更 CM 主題
title.en: Playing with CM: changing a CyanogenMod theme

summary.zh: 整理在 Android 上更換 CyanogenMod 主題的實作筆記，並附上當時參考的示範影片與 Google Play 主題來源。
summary.en: A short practical note on changing CyanogenMod themes on Android, with the demonstration video and Google Play theme source referenced at the time.
